card.name: Middle digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a number of three or more digits, often just before a final 0 (such as 10<<0>>0 or 1<<0>>0 μCi). Also seen in years, areas, and Bible verse numbers.

modes.label: Digit before trailing zeros
modes.description: A digit inside a round number like 100 or 1000, as in dilutions and activity units.
modes.example: subcutaneous administration of a 1:10<<0>>0 solution of epinephrine should

modes.label: Digit inside years and large counts
modes.description: A middle digit in a year or a figure with a comma.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese number words starting with ten (eleven, twelve, thirteen), which suggests a number-continuation effect.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a longer number, such as the 0 in 100 or the 6 in 1760.
